other_conditions: The deceased must have completed ninety days of service as a registered worker.
The deceased must be registered with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The applicant must be the nominee or dependant of the deceased worker.
For unregistered workers, a certificate from the builder or inspector stating that the deceased was a building worker is required.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5,000 is provided to the nominee/dependant of the deceased worker.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
Certificate from builder or inspector (if the deceased was an unregistered worker)
